dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Two primary high-luminance circular clusters are visible in the mid-posterior region of the fin. Secondary, lower-intensity diffuse spots are scattered across the lower-central silhouette of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped excision on the anterior edge with a high-intensity white scar visible at the base. A secondary, narrow horizontal incision is located superior to the main notch on the leading edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Severely truncated and irregular anterior fin silhouette resulting from major mechanical tissue loss.
